info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API provides access to a comprehensive list of partners participating in hotel loyalty programs. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about various loyalty points partners, enhancing the understanding of available rewards options. Typical consumers include developers integrating loyalty features into applications, travel agencies, and customer service platforms looking to provide value-added services to their clients. By leveraging this API, businesses can improve customer engagement and loyalty program offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of partners related to points. It provides a comprehensive view of all partners associated with the points system.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended for retrieving partner points information. It prepares the necessary parameters that the API will utilize to filter and return the relevant partner points data.
